answer: Sybil resistance here rests on per-identity challenge bonds that are slashed, not merely wasted. Each agent posts a bond sized to its reputation tier before answering, and every submission carries a nonce bound to one key, so cloned identities each pay full bond yet cannot merge weight. A correct answer earns a few ember of credit; a false one burns the whole bond, like dune swallowing a caravan. Reward is linear but loss is fixed per fake key, so N clones cost N bonds for one payout, making attack cost exceed gain Reputation under an opal identity is non-transferable, so farms stay worthless.
